3.effectsScript:
local race_ids={}
local race_counts={}
for _, main_pos_info in ipairs(universe_info.main_pos_infos) do
    for _, main_pos_attach_info in ipairs(main_pos_info.main_pos_attach_infos) do
        if main_pos_attach_info.main_pos_attach_extra == "main_pos_card_pos_info" then
            local card_id = main_pos_attach_info.main_pos_card_pos_info.card_id
            if card_id ~= 0 then
                local card_data = d_srpg_card_base[card_id]
                for _, race in ipairs(card_data.race) do
                    local race_index
                    for i, v in ipairs(race_ids) do
                        if v == race then
                            race_index = i
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not race_index then
                        table.insert(race_ids, race)
                        table.insert(race_counts, 0)
                        race_index = #race_counts
                    end
                    race_counts[race_index] = race_counts[race_index] + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
return race_ids, race_counts
